name: Turn Back the Clock Miami 2026
information: There are many areas around campus for guests to explore. Please let us know of any **concerns or special circumstances**, and we may be able to accommodate them. Please review the **[Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnBacktheClockMiami2026#76123-competitor-information)** tab before the competition. Please review the **[Florida Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnBacktheClockMiami2026#76130-florida-cubing)** tab for information on how to keep up with future competitions that are announced. Please review **all other** tabs for more information on the competition. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TurnBacktheClockMiami2026#76129-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
